Method of Attack: Improper restrictions on access to the Running Average Power Limit (RAPL) interface, allowing a local privileged attacker to obtain sensitive information.
Improper implementation of finite state machines (FSMs) in hardware logic, allowing a local privileged attacker to cause a denial of service.
Impacted Systems: Intel processors affected by the vulnerabilities
Ubuntu 16.04 (end-of-life), Ubuntu 18.04 (end-of-life), Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
Attack Vector: Local privileged access to the RAPL interface
Local privileged access to improperly implemented FSMs in hardware logic
